title: Shared Bank Events with Personal Loans — FlexLine Returned-Payment Fee
content:
For FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the shared-event share follows the borrower's Larkspur Personal Loans on the return date: when a personal-loan payment was returned on the same date and a personal-loan returned-payment fee was booked that date, the share is 0.75; when a personal-loan payment was returned on the same date with no such fee, the share is 0.90; with no personal-loan return on that date the share is 1.00.

The share multiplies the line's fee as figured, before the fee is held to no more than the minimum payment due and rounded to the cent.

**Records read.** The borrower's Personal Loans entries dated on the line's return date: returned-payment entries, and returned-payment fee entries, on any of the borrower's personal loans.

| Personal-loan returned payment on the line's return date | Personal-loan returned-payment fee booked that date | Share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.75 |
| yes | no | 0.90 |
| no | — | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical case:* a line payment and a personal-loan payment both returned on 6 August, with a personal-loan returned-payment fee also dated 6 August: 0.75. If the personal-loan fee is dated 9 August instead: 0.90.
